```python
def dsl3(I):
    S = shape(I)
    B = canvas(ZERO, S)
    f0 = lbind(ofcolor, I)
    f1 = lbind(lbind(fill, B), ONE)
    f2 = compose(vmirror, f1)
    f3 = compose(rbind(ofcolor, ONE), f2)
    f = fork(recolor, identity, f3)
    C = palette(I)
    OBJS = apply(f, C)
    OBJ = merge(OBJS)
    O = paint(B, OBJ)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    idx = asindices(I)
    ones = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    twos = ofcolor(I, TWO)
    r = apply(lbind(add, RIGHT), ones)
    l = apply(lbind(add, LEFT), ones)
    u = apply(lbind(add, UP), ones)
    d = apply(lbind(add, DOWN), ones)
    one_n = combine(combine(l, r), combine(u, d))
    one_n = intersection(one_n, idx)
    dr = apply(lbind(add, UNITY), twos)
    ul = apply(lbind(add, NEG_UNITY), twos)
    ur = apply(lbind(add, UP_RIGHT), twos)
    dl = apply(lbind(add, DOWN_LEFT), twos)
    two_n = combine(combine(dr, ul), combine(ur, dl))
    two_n = intersection(two_n, idx)
    g7 = fill(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), SEVEN, one_n)
    g4 = fill(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), FOUR, two_n)
    o7 = asobject(g7)
    o4 = asobject(g4)
    O = underpaint(I, o7)
    O = underpaint(O, o4)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Global geometric transform (rotate, solve by edges, rotate back)
    R = rot90(I)
    ro = objects(R, T, F, T)
    rtwo = first(colorfilter(ro, TWO))
    reight = first(colorfilter(ro, EIGHT))
    rh = tojvec(decrement(subtract(leftmost(reight), rightmost(rtwo))))
    rv = toivec(decrement(subtract(uppermost(reight), lowermost(rtwo))))
    roff = branch(hmatching(rtwo, reight), rh, rv)
    rbase = cover(R, rtwo)
    rshift = shift(toindices(rtwo), roff)
    rnew = recolor(TWO, rshift)
    OR = paint(rbase, rnew)
    O = rot270(OR)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    dims = shape(I)
    z = ofcolor(I, ZERO)
    p_obj = recolor(ONE, z)
    p = paint(canvas(ZERO, dims), p_obj)
    row = hconcat(p, hconcat(p, p))
    t = vconcat(row, vconcat(row, row))
    nzI = difference(asindices(I), z)
    nz_grid = paint(canvas(ZERO, dims), recolor(ONE, nzI))
    bmask = difference(asindices(upscale(nz_grid, THREE)), ofcolor(upscale(nz_grid, THREE), ZERO))
    tmask = ofcolor(t, ONE)
    k = intersection(bmask, tmask)
    c = other(palette(I), ZERO)
    obj = recolor(c, k)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, multiply(dims, THREE)), obj)
    return O
```

```python
    I2 = size(intersection(X2, Xtop))
    B = branch(greater(I1, I2), Mid1, Mid2)
    O = vconcat(A, B)
    return O
```

```python
    W2 = width(SG)

    Cg = canvas(SC, CH)
    RO = asobject(Rg)
    CO = asobject(Cg)
    RC = size(occurrences(SG, RO))
    CC = size(occurrences(SG, CO))
    HD = add(RC, ONE)
    WD = add(CC, ONE)
    D = astuple(HD, WD)
    O = canvas(BG, D)
    return O
```

```python
    BG = mostcolor(I)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)

    s = colorcount(I, SC)
    L0 = first(asindices(I))

    CH = multiply(C, H)
    N = subtract(s, CH)

    HD = add(R, ONE)
    WD = add(C, ONE)
    D = astuple(HD, WD)
    O = canvas(BG, D)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
```
```python
    S = subgrid(ofcolor(I, ONE), I)
    P = ofcolor(S, ONE)
    K = compress(replace(I, ONE, ZERO))
    Kh = hupscale(K, width(S))
    Kbig = vupscale(Kh, height(S))
    dims = multiply(shape(S), shape(K))
    pos = toindices(asobject(K))
    off = apply(rbind(multiply, shape(S)), pos)
    tiles = prapply(add, off, P)
    M = toobject(tiles, Kbig)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, dims), M)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Pixel-level relational reasoning using diagonal neighbors (shift-based split)
    S = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    plus_neighbors = combine(shift(S, UNITY), shift(S, NEG_UNITY))          # (+1,+1) or (-1,-1)
    minus_neighbors = combine(shift(S, UP_RIGHT), shift(S, DOWN_LEFT))      # (-1,+1) or (+1,-1)
    plus = intersection(S, plus_neighbors)
    minus = intersection(S, minus_neighbors)
    colored = combine(recolor(EIGHT, plus), recolor(TWO, minus))
    O = paint(I, colored)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Geometric per-object: subset-of UL-LR diagonal vs its complement, then fill safely
    objs = colorfilter(objects(I, T, T, T), FIVE)
    on_plus = fork(equality, toindices, fork(intersection, toindices, fork(connect, ulcorner, lrcorner)))
    asc = mfilter(objs, on_plus)
    asc_inds = merge(mapply(toindices, asc))
    S = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    desc_inds = difference(S, asc_inds)
    Oa = branch(greater(size(asc_inds), ZERO), fill(I, EIGHT, asc_inds), I)
    Ob = branch(greater(size(desc_inds), ZERO), fill(Oa, TWO, desc_inds), Oa)
    return Ob
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Adaptive relational: choose mapping by which diagonal neighbor class is larger
    S = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    plus = intersection(S, combine(shift(S, UNITY), shift(S, NEG_UNITY)))
    minus = intersection(S, combine(shift(S, UP_RIGHT), shift(S, DOWN_LEFT)))

    A = paint(I, combine(recolor(EIGHT, plus), recolor(TWO, minus)))
    B = paint(I, combine(recolor(TWO, plus), recolor(EIGHT, minus)))
    O = branch(cond, A, B)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    five = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    c = corners(five)
    miss = first(difference(c, five))
    tl = ulcorner(five)
    tr = urcorner(five)
    bl = llcorner(five)
    br = lrcorner(five)
    cond = both(contained(tl, five), contained(br, five))
    diag = branch(cond, connect(tl, br), connect(tr, bl))
    pbox = box(five)
    rowedge = intersection(hfrontier(miss), pbox)
    coledge = intersection(vfrontier(miss), pbox)
    borders = combine(rowedge, coledge)
    patch = combine(diag, borders)
    O = underfill(I, EIGHT, patch)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    samecolor = compose(lbind(colorfilter, objs), color)
    rmap = lbind(apply, rightmost)
    maxright_in_color = compose(maximum, rmap)
    Rc = compose(maxright_in_color, samecolor)
    is_blocked = fork(equality, rightmost, Rc)
    blocked = sfilter(objs, is_blocked)
    allowed = difference(objs, blocked)
    shifted = apply(rbind(shift, RIGHT), allowed)
    merged = merge(combine(shifted, blocked))
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), merged)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    zeros8 = replace(I, ZERO, EIGHT)
    z1 = replace(zeros8, ONE, ZERO)
    z2 = replace(z1, NINE, ZERO)
    mirrored = vmirror(z2)
    both = cellwise(z2, mirrored, ZERO)
    axis = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    L1 = shift(axis, LEFT)
    L2 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, TWO))
    L3 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, THREE))
    leftarea = combine(L1, combine(L2, L3))
    O = crop(both, ulcorner(leftarea), astuple(height(I), THREE))
    return O
```

```python
    L = crop(LH, ORIGIN, dims)
    R = crop(RH, astuple(0, 1), dims)
    L8 = replace(replace(L, ZERO, EIGHT), NINE, ZERO)
    R8 = replace(replace(R, ZERO, EIGHT), NINE, ZERO)
    O = cellwise(L8, R8, ZERO)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    NZ = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    PARTS = fgpartition(I)
    COLORS = colorfilter(PARTS, ZERO)
    NONZ = remove(ofcolor(I, ZERO), PARTS)
    # anchor per color at its uppermost occurrence via cropping its subgrid top row
    ANCH = NONZ
    S_UP = compose(rbind(shoot, UP_RIGHT), compose(first, toindices))
    S_DL = compose(rbind(shoot, DOWN_LEFT), compose(first, toindices))
    LINES = apply(fork(recolor, color, fork(combine, S_UP, S_DL)), ANCH)
    BIG = merge(LINES)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), BIG)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    NZ = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    TILE = subgrid(NZ, I)
    TH = height(TILE)
    TW = width(TILE)
    TOP = crop(TILE, ORIGIN, astuple(ONE, TW))
    TOPNZ = difference(asindices(TOP), ofcolor(TOP, ZERO))
    ROBJ = toobject(TOPNZ, TOP)
    SHIFT0 = ulcorner(NZ)
    BASE = shift(ROBJ, SHIFT0)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    RO = interval(0, H, ONE)
    CO = interval(0, W, ONE)
    RV = apply(toivec, RO)
    CV = apply(tojvec, RO)
    DIAG = papply(add, RV, CV)
    COLS = apply(tojvec, CO)
    OFFS = prapply(add, DIAG, COLS)
    SH = apply(lbind(shift, BASE), OFFS)
    BIG = merge(SH)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), BIG)
    return O
```

```python
    CO = interval(0, W, THREE)
```
```python
    DV = apply(toivec, RO)
```
```python
    DH = apply(tojvec, CO)
```
```python
    NDV = apply(invert, DV)
    NDH = apply(invert, DH)
    VOFFS = combine(DV, NDV)
    HOFFS = combine(DH, NDH)
    OFFS = prapply(add, VOFFS, HOFFS)
    SH = apply(lbind(shift, BASE), OFFS)
    BIG = merge(SH)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), BIG)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
```
```python
    P = asindices(I)
    ones = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    sixes = ofcolor(I, SIX)
    base = replace(I, SIX, EIGHT)
    def per(o):
        p = initset(o)
        predh = compose(lbind(hmatching, p), initset)
        predv = compose(lbind(vmatching, p), initset)
        cond = fork(either, predh, predv)
        aligned = sfilter(sixes, cond)
        comp = compose(lbind(manhattan, p), initset)
        q = valmin(aligned, comp)
        qq = initset(q)
        d = gravitate(p, qq)
        orth = branch(equality(d, UP), LEFT, branch(equality(d, DOWN), RIGHT, branch(equality(d, LEFT), DOWN, UP)))
        dist = manhattan(p, qq)
        off = multiply(orth, dist)
        t = add(o, off)
        return intersection(initset(t), P)
    T = merge(apply(per, ones))
    O = fill(base, SEVEN, T)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    P = asindices(I)
    base = replace(I, SIX, EIGHT)
    ones = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    sixes = ofcolor(I, SIX)
    def per(o):
        p = initset(o)
        predh = compose(lbind(hmatching, p), initset)
        predv = compose(lbind(vmatching, p), initset)
        cond = fork(either, predh, predv)
        aligned = sfilter(sixes, cond)
        comp = compose(lbind(manhattan, p), initset)
        q = argmin(aligned, comp)
        dirv = sign(subtract(q, o))
        orth = branch(equality(dirv, UP), LEFT, branch(equality(dirv, DOWN), RIGHT, branch(equality(dirv, LEFT), DOWN, UP)))
        dist = manhattan(p, initset(q))
        t = add(o, multiply(orth, dist))
        return intersection(initset(t), P)
    T = merge(apply(per, ones))
    O = fill(base, SEVEN, T)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Geometric (directional shifts): build plus and diagonals by shifting centers by step 1 and 2
    pal = palette(I)
    c = leastcolor(I)
    a = other(remove(ZERO, pal), c)
    centers = ofcolor(I, c)
    plus1 = combine(shift(centers, RIGHT), shift(centers, LEFT))
    plus2 = combine(shift(centers, UP), shift(centers, DOWN))
    plus3 = combine(shift(centers, double(RIGHT)), shift(centers, double(LEFT)))
    plus4 = combine(shift(centers, double(UP)), shift(centers, double(DOWN)))
    plus = combine(combine(centers, combine(plus1, plus2)), combine(plus3, plus4))
    diag1 = combine(shift(centers, UNITY), shift(centers, NEG_UNITY))
    diag2 = combine(shift(centers, UP_RIGHT), shift(centers, DOWN_LEFT))
    diag3 = combine(shift(centers, double(UNITY)), shift(centers, double(NEG_UNITY)))
    diag4 = combine(shift(centers, double(UP_RIGHT)), shift(centers, double(DOWN_LEFT)))
    diag = combine(combine(centers, combine(diag1, diag2)), combine(diag3, diag4))
    O = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O = fill(O, a, plus)
    O = fill(O, c, diag)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Global transformation: crop top (all foreground), then tile the top-5-rows-pattern (with 5->0) to fill the remainder
    FG = objects(I, T, F, T)
    FGinds = mapply(toindices, FG)
    top_h = increment(lowermost(FGinds))
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    M5 = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    m = height(M5)
    motif = crop(I, ORIGIN, astuple(m, W))
    motif0 = replace(motif, FIVE, ZERO)
    bottom_h = subtract(H, top_h)
    k = divide(bottom_h, m)
    rep = vupscale(motif0, k)
    top = crop(I, ORIGIN, astuple(top_h, W))
    O = vconcat(top, rep)
    return O
```

```python
    R = hsplit(I, THREE)
    r0 = first(R)
    r2 = last(R)
    r1 = first(remove(r0, remove(r2, R)))
    C = vsplit(I, THREE)
    c0 = first(C)
    c2 = last(C)

    H3x9 = hconcat(I, hconcat(I, I))
    V9x3 = vconcat(I, vconcat(I, I))
    Z3x9 = canvas(ZERO, astuple(THREE, NINE))

    b1 = branch(equality(size(palette(r1)), ONE), H3x9, Z3x9)

    cb0 = branch(equality(size(palette(c0)), ONE), V9x3, Z9x3)
    cb1 = branch(equality(size(palette(c1)), ONE), V9x3, Z9x3)
```

```python
    H3x9 = hconcat(I, hconcat(I, I))

    right = hconcat(Z9x3, hconcat(Z9x3, V9x3))
    lj = leftmost(L)
    GV = branch(equality(lj, ZERO), left, branch(equality(lj, ONE), midc, right))
    O = branch(hline(L), GH, GV)
    return O
```

```python
    Z9x3 = canvas(ZERO, astuple(NINE, THREE))
    baseH = vconcat(H3x9, vconcat(Z3x9, Z3x9))
    baseV = hconcat(V9x3, hconcat(Z9x3, Z9x3))
    topHset = mfilter(P, fork(both, condH, compose(rbind(equality, ZERO), uppermost)))
    midHset = mfilter(P, fork(both, condH, compose(rbind(equality, ONE), uppermost)))
    bTop = greater(size(topHset), ZERO)
    bMid = greater(size(midHset), ZERO)
    offH1 = toivec(ZERO)
    offH2 = toivec(THREE)
    offH3 = multiply(TWO, toivec(THREE))
    offH = branch(bTop, offH1, branch(bMid, offH2, offH3))
    leftVset = mfilter(P, fork(both, condV, compose(rbind(equality, ZERO), leftmost)))

    Z9x9 = canvas(ZERO, astuple(NINE, NINE))
    OH = move(Z9x9, asobject(baseH), offH)
    OV = move(Z9x9, asobject(baseV), offV)
    O = branch(hasH, OH, OV)
    return O
```

```python
    A = asindices(I)
    L = leftmost(A)
    R = rightmost(A)
    B = lowermost(A)
    OB = objects(I, T, F, T)
    U = argmin(OB, uppermost)
    D = argmax(OB, uppermost)
    RU = uppermost(U)
    RD = uppermost(D)
    MID = halve(add(RU, RD))
    MIDP = increment(MID)
    CU = color(U)
    CD = color(D)
    RTOP = connect(astuple(0, L), astuple(0, R))
    RRU = connect(astuple(RU, L), astuple(RU, R))
    RRD = connect(astuple(RD, L), astuple(RD, R))

    PTOP = combine(combine(RTOP, RRU), combine(CLT, CRT))

    OBJ = recolor(CD, PBOT)
```

```python
    MIDP = increment(MID)
    CU = color(U)
    CD = color(D)
    TOPRECT = backdrop(connect(astuple(0, 0), astuple(MID, R)))
    BOTRECT = backdrop(connect(astuple(MIDP, 0), astuple(B, R)))
    TOPFRAME = difference(box(TOPRECT), hfrontier(astuple(MID, 0)))
    BOTFRAME = difference(box(BOTRECT), hfrontier(astuple(MIDP, 0)))
    RRU = hfrontier(astuple(RU, 0))
    RRD = hfrontier(astuple(RD, 0))
    PTOP = combine(TOPFRAME, RRU)
    PBOT = combine(BOTFRAME, RRD)
    OT = recolor(CU, PTOP)
    OBJ = recolor(CD, PBOT)
    O0 = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O1 = paint(O0, OT)
    O2 = paint(O1, OBJ)
    return O2
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Relational replication via shoots + frontiers with border-based orientation
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    P = mapply(toindices, OS)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    Hm1 = subtract(H, ONE)
    Wm1 = subtract(W, ONE)
    vert = both(equality(top, ZERO), equality(bot, Hm1))
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    o1 = first(OS)
    o2 = last(OS)
    # horizontal stripes for each seed
    l1 = first(toindices(o1))
    s1p = toivec(dv)
    s1n = toivec(invert(dv))
    L1 = combine(combine(shoot(l1, s1p), shoot(l1, s1n)), initset(l1))
    R1 = mapply(hfrontier, L1)
    H1 = recolor(color(o1), R1)
    l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    s2p = toivec(dv)
    s2n = toivec(invert(dv))
    L2 = combine(combine(shoot(l2, s2p), shoot(l2, s2n)), initset(l2))
    R2 = mapply(hfrontier, L2)
    H2 = recolor(color(o2), R2)
    HOBJ = combine(H1, H2)
    # vertical stripes for each seed
    c1p = tojvec(dh)
    c1n = tojvec(invert(dh))
    C1A = combine(combine(shoot(l1, c1p), shoot(l1, c1n)), initset(l1))
    V1 = mapply(vfrontier, C1A)
    VOBJ1 = recolor(color(o1), V1)
    C2A = combine(combine(shoot(l2, c1p), shoot(l2, c1n)), initset(l2))
    V2 = mapply(vfrontier, C2A)
    VOBJ2 = recolor(color(o2), V2)
    VOBJ = combine(VOBJ1, VOBJ2)
    OOBJ = branch(vert, VOBJ, HOBJ)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), OOBJ)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Global stripes via shoots + frontiers with minimal-distance orientation (safe steps)
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    P = mapply(toindices, OS)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    o1 = first(OS)
    o2 = last(OS)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1))
    l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    # horizontal pattern from both seeds
    L1h = combine(combine(shoot(l1, toivec(stepR)), shoot(l1, toivec(invert(stepR)))), initset(l1))
    R1 = mapply(hfrontier, L1h)
    H1 = recolor(color(o1), R1)
    L2h = combine(combine(shoot(l2, toivec(stepR)), shoot(l2, toivec(invert(stepR)))), initset(l2))
    R2 = mapply(hfrontier, L2h)
    H2 = recolor(color(o2), R2)
    HOBJ = combine(H1, H2)
    # vertical pattern from both seeds
    L1v = combine(combine(shoot(l1, tojvec(stepC)), shoot(l1, tojvec(invert(stepC)))), initset(l1))
    C1 = mapply(vfrontier, L1v)
    V1 = recolor(color(o1), C1)
    L2v = combine(combine(shoot(l2, tojvec(stepC)), shoot(l2, tojvec(invert(stepC)))), initset(l2))
    C2 = mapply(vfrontier, L2v)
    V2 = recolor(color(o2), C2)
    VOBJ = combine(V1, V2)
    # choose orientation with smaller nonzero distance
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(either(equality(dv, ZERO), greater(dv, dh))))
    OOBJ = branch(hsel, HOBJ, VOBJ)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), OOBJ)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric orientation (min axis) + fill-based construction from frontier masks
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    P = mapply(toindices, OS)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    o1 = first(OS)
    o2 = last(OS)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1))
    l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    # build horizontal masks and fill
    L1h = combine(combine(shoot(l1, toivec(stepR)), shoot(l1, toivec(invert(stepR)))), initset(l1))
    R1 = mapply(hfrontier, L1h)
    L2h = combine(combine(shoot(l2, toivec(stepR)), shoot(l2, toivec(invert(stepR)))), initset(l2))
    R2 = mapply(hfrontier, L2h)
    HB = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    HF = fill(fill(HB, color(o1), R1), color(o2), R2)
    # build vertical masks and fill
    L1v = combine(combine(shoot(l1, tojvec(stepC)), shoot(l1, tojvec(invert(stepC)))), initset(l1))
    C1 = mapply(vfrontier, L1v)
    L2v = combine(combine(shoot(l2, tojvec(stepC)), shoot(l2, tojvec(invert(stepC)))), initset(l2))
    C2 = mapply(vfrontier, L2v)
    VB = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    VF = fill(fill(VB, color(o1), C1), color(o2), C2)
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(either(equality(dv, ZERO), greater(dv, dh))))
    O = branch(hsel, HF, VF)
    return O
```

```python
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)

    W = width(I)

    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)

    o2 = last(OS)
```

```python
    # Global periodic mask via color-pair periods (hperiod/vperiod) and frontier shifts
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    o1 = first(OS)
    o2 = last(OS)
    c1 = color(o1)
    c2 = color(o2)
    p1 = first(toindices(o1))
    p2 = first(toindices(o2))
    P = combine(toindices(o1), toindices(o2))
    O2 = toobject(P, I)
    vr = vperiod(O2)
    hr = hperiod(O2)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    stepR = branch(equality(vr, ZERO), ONE, vr)
    stepC = branch(equality(hr, ZERO), ONE, hr)

    offsR = combine(offsRpos, apply(invert, offsRpos))
    offsCpos = apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC))

    baseR2 = hfrontier(p2)
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Color filtering: build stripe masks per color via frontier shifts and underpaint
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    c1 = color(first(OS))
    c2 = color(last(OS))
    S1 = ofcolor(I, c1)
    S2 = ofcolor(I, c2)
    l1 = first(S1)
    l2 = first(S2)
    P = combine(S1, S2)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    offsR = combine(apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, stepR)), apply(invert, apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, stepR))))
    offsC = combine(apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC)), apply(invert, apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC))))
    HR1 = mapply(lbind(shift, hfrontier(l1)), offsR)
    HR2 = mapply(lbind(shift, hfrontier(l2)), offsR)
    HOBJ = combine(recolor(c1, HR1), recolor(c2, HR2))
    VC1 = mapply(lbind(shift, vfrontier(l1)), offsC)
    VC2 = mapply(lbind(shift, vfrontier(l2)), offsC)
    VOBJ = combine(recolor(c1, VC1), recolor(c2, VC2))
    B = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    Hfilled = underpaint(underpaint(B, HOBJ), HOBJ)  # idempotent layering
    Vfilled = underpaint(underpaint(B, VOBJ), VOBJ)
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(either(equality(dv, ZERO), greater(dv, dh))))
    O = branch(hsel, Hfilled, Vfilled)
    return O
```

```python
    # Relational: cartesian product (seeds x offsets) shifted frontiers
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    P = mapply(toindices, OS)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)

    o2 = last(OS)

    c2 = color(o2)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1))
    l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    BR = initset(hfrontier(l1))
    BR = insert(hfrontier(l2), BR)
    BC = initset(vfrontier(l1))
    BC = insert(vfrontier(l2), BC)

    offsC = combine(apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC)), apply(invert, apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC))))
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric alignment: build bidirectional lines via shoot and underpaint periodically
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    o1 = first(OS); o2 = last(OS)
    c1 = color(o1); c2 = color(o2)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1)); l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    P = combine(toindices(o1), toindices(o2))
    dv = subtract(lowermost(P), uppermost(P))
    dh = subtract(rightmost(P), leftmost(P))
    H = height(I); W = width(I)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    offsR = apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, stepR))
    offsC = apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC))
    HR = combine(recolor(c1, combine(shoot(l1, LEFT), shoot(l1, RIGHT))),
                 recolor(c2, combine(shoot(l2, LEFT), shoot(l2, RIGHT))))
    VR = combine(recolor(c1, combine(shoot(l1, UP), shoot(l1, DOWN))),
                 recolor(c2, combine(shoot(l2, UP), shoot(l2, DOWN))))
    HOBJ = merge(prapply(shift, HR, offsR))
    VOBJ = merge(prapply(shift, VR, offsC))
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(greater(dv, dh)))
    O = underpaint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), branch(hsel, HOBJ, VOBJ))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    # Object extraction: derive period from the bounding subgrid; tile doubled-gap stripes
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    o1 = first(OS); o2 = last(OS)
    c1 = color(o1); c2 = color(o2)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1)); l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    P = combine(toindices(o1), toindices(o2))
    SG = subgrid(P, I)
    dv = subtract(height(SG), ONE)
    dh = subtract(width(SG), ONE)
    H = height(I); W = width(I)
    baseR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    baseC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    stepR = double(baseR)
    stepC = double(baseC)
    offsR = apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, stepR))
    offsC = apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC))
    Row1 = recolor(c1, combine(shoot(l1, LEFT), shoot(l1, RIGHT)))
    Row2 = recolor(c2, combine(shoot(l2, LEFT), shoot(l2, RIGHT)))
    Col1 = recolor(c1, combine(shoot(l1, UP), shoot(l1, DOWN)))
    Col2 = recolor(c2, combine(shoot(l2, UP), shoot(l2, DOWN)))
    HOBJ = combine(merge(prapply(shift, initset(Row1), offsR)),
                   merge(prapply(shift, initset(Row2), offsR)))
    VOBJ = combine(merge(prapply(shift, initset(Col1), offsC)),
                   merge(prapply(shift, initset(Col2), offsC)))
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(greater(dv, dh)))
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), branch(hsel, HOBJ, VOBJ))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Color filtering: get seeds per color, build axis rays, replicate via mapply with doubled gaps
    CS = palette(I)
    c1 = first(CS); c2 = last(CS)
    S1 = ofcolor(I, c1); S2 = ofcolor(I, c2)
    l1 = first(S1); l2 = first(S2)
    P = combine(S1, S2)
    dv = subtract(lowermost(P), uppermost(P))
    dh = subtract(rightmost(P), leftmost(P))
    H = height(I); W = width(I)
    baseR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    baseC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    stepR = double(baseR)
    stepC = double(baseC)
    offsR = apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, stepR))
    offsC = apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC))
    R1 = recolor(c1, combine(shoot(l1, LEFT), shoot(l1, RIGHT)))
    R2 = recolor(c2, combine(shoot(l2, LEFT), shoot(l2, RIGHT)))
    C1 = recolor(c1, combine(shoot(l1, UP), shoot(l1, DOWN)))
    C2 = recolor(c2, combine(shoot(l2, UP), shoot(l2, DOWN)))
    HR = combine(merge(mapply(lbind(shift, R1), offsR)),
                 merge(mapply(lbind(shift, R2), offsR)))
    VR = combine(merge(mapply(lbind(shift, C1), offsC)),
                 merge(mapply(lbind(shift, C2), offsC)))
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(greater(dv, dh)))
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), branch(hsel, HR, VR))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational interleaving: even/odd phase offsets using base gap; avoid overlaps by staggering
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    o1 = first(OS); o2 = last(OS)
    c1 = color(o1); c2 = color(o2)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1)); l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    P = combine(toindices(o1), toindices(o2))
    dv = subtract(lowermost(P), uppermost(P))
    dh = subtract(rightmost(P), leftmost(P))
    H = height(I); W = width(I)
    baseR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    baseC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    evenR = apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, double(baseR)))
    oddR  = mapply(lbind(add, toivec(baseR)), evenR)
    evenC = apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, double(baseC)))
    oddC  = mapply(lbind(add, tojvec(baseC)), evenC)
    RL1 = recolor(c1, combine(shoot(l1, LEFT), shoot(l1, RIGHT)))
    RL2 = recolor(c2, combine(shoot(l2, LEFT), shoot(l2, RIGHT)))
    CL1 = recolor(c1, combine(shoot(l1, UP), shoot(l1, DOWN)))
    CL2 = recolor(c2, combine(shoot(l2, UP), shoot(l2, DOWN)))
    HOBJ = combine(merge(prapply(shift, initset(RL1), evenR)),
                   merge(prapply(shift, initset(RL2), oddR)))
    VOBJ = combine(merge(prapply(shift, initset(CL1), evenC)),
                   merge(prapply(shift, initset(CL2), oddC)))
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(greater(dv, dh)))
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), branch(hsel, HOBJ, VOBJ))
    return O
```

```python
    S_run = difference(intersection(shift(RR, RIGHT), Z), AboveE)
    Rays = mapply(rbind(shoot, RIGHT), totuple(S_run))
    S_step = difference(intersection(shift(shift(RR, RIGHT), RIGHT), Z), AboveE)
    Q1 = S_step
    Q2 = shift(Q1, ZERO_BY_TWO)
    Q3 = shift(Q2, ZERO_BY_TWO)
    Q4 = shift(Q3, ZERO_BY_TWO)
    Q5 = shift(Q4, ZERO_BY_TWO)
    Points = combine(combine(Q1, Q2), combine(combine(Q3, Q4), Q5))
    Rays_masked = intersection(Rays, RowAdj)
    Points_masked = difference(Points, RowAdj)
    Patch = combine(Rays_masked, Points_masked)
    O = underfill(I, ONE, Patch)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    E = ofcolor(I, EIGHT)
    Z = ofcolor(I, ZERO)
    OE = toobject(E, I)
    HP = hperiod(OE)
    AboveE = shift(E, UP)
    R = difference(E, shift(E, LEFT))
    L8 = intersection(E, shift(E, RIGHT))
    Diag = combine(shift(E, UP_RIGHT), shift(E, DOWN_LEFT))
    A = shift(intersection(R, L8), RIGHT)
    B = shift(shift(intersection(R, Diag), RIGHT), RIGHT)
    C = shift(difference(R, combine(L8, Diag)), RIGHT)
    Af = difference(intersection(A, Z), AboveE)
    Bf = difference(intersection(B, Z), AboveE)
    Cf = difference(intersection(C, Z), AboveE)
    RaysA = mapply(rbind(shoot, RIGHT), totuple(Af))
    RaysB = mapply(rbind(shoot, RIGHT), totuple(Bf))
    RaysC = mapply(rbind(shoot, RIGHT), totuple(Cf))
    RaysP1 = combine(combine(RaysA, RaysB), shift(RaysC, DOWN))
    RR = difference(E, shift(E, RIGHT))
    S0 = difference(intersection(shift(shift(RR, RIGHT), RIGHT), Z), AboveE)
    U1 = shift(S0, ZERO_BY_TWO)
    U2 = shift(U1, ZERO_BY_TWO)
    U3 = shift(U2, ZERO_BY_TWO)
    U4 = shift(U3, ZERO_BY_TWO)
    U5 = shift(U4, ZERO_BY_TWO)
    Points = combine(combine(S0, U1), combine(combine(U2, U3), combine(U4, U5)))
    Patch = branch(equality(HP, TWO), Points, RaysP1)
    O = underfill(I, ONE, Patch)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Cross propagation from unique center: extend colors along four cardinal directions
    colors = palette(I)
    nz = remove(ZERO, colors)
    countf = lbind(colorcount, I)
    ctrcol = valmin(nz, countf)
    ctrset = ofcolor(I, ctrcol)
    ctr = first(ctrset)
    L = add(ctr, LEFT)
    R = add(ctr, RIGHT)
    U = add(ctr, UP)
    D = add(ctr, DOWN)
    lc = index(I, L)
    rc = index(I, R)
    uc = index(I, U)
    dc = index(I, D)
    leftseg = shoot(ctr, LEFT)
    rightseg = shoot(ctr, RIGHT)
    upseg = shoot(ctr, UP)
    downseg = shoot(ctr, DOWN)
    O = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O = fill(O, lc, leftseg)
    O = fill(O, rc, rightseg)
    O = fill(O, uc, upseg)
    O = fill(O, dc, downseg)
    O = fill(O, ctrcol, initset(ctr))
    return O
```

```python
    ctrset = ofcolor(I, ctrcol)

    lc = index(I, L); rc = index(I, R); uc = index(I, U); dc = index(I, D)
    UL = add(U, LEFT); UR = add(U, RIGHT); DL = add(D, LEFT); DR = add(D, RIGHT)
    ul = add(ctr, UL); ur = add(ctr, UR); dl = add(ctr, DL); dr = add(ctr, DR)
    ulc = index(I, ul); urc = index(I, ur); dlc = index(I, dl); drc = index(I, dr)
    leftseg = shoot(ctr, LEFT); rightseg = shoot(ctr, RIGHT); upseg = shoot(ctr, UP); downseg = shoot(ctr, DOWN)
    ulray = shoot(ul, UP_LEFT); urray = shoot(ur, UP_RIGHT); dlray = shoot(dl, DOWN_LEFT); drray = shoot(dr, add(DOWN, RIGHT))
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Assemble rays as recolored objects and paint them
    colors = palette(I)
    nz = remove(ZERO, colors)
    countf = lbind(colorcount, I)
    ctrcol = valmin(nz, countf)
    ctr = first(ofcolor(I, ctrcol))
    L = add(ctr, LEFT); R = add(ctr, RIGHT); U = add(ctr, UP); D = add(ctr, DOWN)
    UL = add(U, LEFT); UR = add(U, RIGHT); DL = add(D, LEFT); DR = add(D, RIGHT)
    leftobj = recolor(index(I, L), shoot(ctr, LEFT))
    rightobj = recolor(index(I, R), shoot(ctr, RIGHT))
    upobj = recolor(index(I, U), shoot(ctr, UP))
    downobj = recolor(index(I, D), shoot(ctr, DOWN))
    ulobj = recolor(index(I, add(ctr, UL)), shoot(add(ctr, UL), UP_LEFT))
    urobj = recolor(index(I, add(ctr, UR)), shoot(add(ctr, UR), UP_RIGHT))
    dlobj = recolor(index(I, add(ctr, DL)), shoot(add(ctr, DL), DOWN_LEFT))
    drobj = recolor(index(I, add(ctr, DR)), shoot(add(ctr, DR), add(DOWN, RIGHT)))
    centerobj = recolor(ctrcol, initset(ctr))
    O = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O = paint(O, leftobj)
    O = paint(O, rightobj)
    O = paint(O, upobj)
    O = paint(O, downobj)
    O = paint(O, ulobj)
    O = paint(O, urobj)
    O = paint(O, dlobj)
    O = paint(O, drobj)
    O = paint(O, centerobj)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Use row/column frontiers and half-masks via set difference (geometric row/col split)
    colors = palette(I)
    nz = remove(ZERO, colors)
    countf = lbind(colorcount, I)
    ctrcol = valmin(nz, countf)
    ctr = first(ofcolor(I, ctrcol))
    L = add(ctr, LEFT); R = add(ctr, RIGHT); U = add(ctr, UP); D = add(ctr, DOWN)
    lc = index(I, L); rc = index(I, R); uc = index(I, U); dc = index(I, D)
    rowmask = hfrontier(ctr)
    colmask = vfrontier(ctr)
    rightseg = shoot(ctr, RIGHT)
    leftseg = difference(rowmask, rightseg)
    downseg = shoot(ctr, DOWN)
    upseg = difference(colmask, downseg)
    O = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O = fill(O, lc, leftseg)
    O = fill(O, rc, rightseg)
    O = fill(O, uc, upseg)
    O = fill(O, dc, downseg)
    O = fill(O, ctrcol, initset(ctr))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational rays: extend from 3x3 neighbors that are diagonally adjacent to center
    colors = palette(I)
    nz = remove(ZERO, colors)
    countf = lbind(colorcount, I)
    ctrcol = valmin(nz, countf)
    ctr = first(ofcolor(I, ctrcol))
    L = add(ctr, LEFT); R = add(ctr, RIGHT); U = add(ctr, UP); D = add(ctr, DOWN)
    UL = add(U, LEFT); UR = add(U, RIGHT); DL = add(D, LEFT); DR = add(D, RIGHT)
    # Cardinal cross
    O = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O = fill(O, index(I, L), shoot(ctr, LEFT))
    O = fill(O, index(I, R), shoot(ctr, RIGHT))
    O = fill(O, index(I, U), shoot(ctr, UP))
    O = fill(O, index(I, D), shoot(ctr, DOWN))
    # Two principal diagonals away from center
    O = fill(O, index(I, add(ctr, UL)), shoot(add(ctr, UL), UP_LEFT))
    O = fill(O, index(I, add(ctr, DR)), shoot(add(ctr, DR), add(DOWN, RIGHT)))
    O = fill(O, ctrcol, initset(ctr))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    dims = shape(I)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    Z = canvas(ZERO, dims)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)

    const0 = lbind(identity, ZERO)
    W1 = decrement(W)
    constw1 = lbind(identity, W1)

    # full row at object row
    startloc = fork(astuple, uppermost, const0)
    rowpatch = compose(rbind(shoot, RIGHT), startloc)
    rowobj = fork(recolor, color, rowpatch)

    # small vertical segments (r-1 to r+1) on both borders
    dec_r = compose(decrement, uppermost)
    inc_r = compose(increment, uppermost)

    left_top = fork(astuple, dec_r, const0)
    left_bot = fork(astuple, inc_r, const0)
    left_seg = fork(connect, left_top, left_bot)
    left_obj = fork(recolor, color, left_seg)

    right_top = fork(astuple, dec_r, constw1)
    right_bot = fork(astuple, inc_r, constw1)
    right_seg = fork(connect, right_top, right_bot)
    right_obj = fork(recolor, color, right_seg)

    sides = fork(combine, left_obj, right_obj)
    triplet = fork(combine, rowobj, sides)
    segs = mapply(triplet, objs)

    # also enforce edge rows colored by top/bottom objects
    topobj = argmin(objs, uppermost)
    botobj = argmax(objs, lowermost)
    toprow = recolor(color(topobj), shoot(astuple(ZERO, ZERO), RIGHT))
    H1 = decrement(H)
    botrow = recolor(color(botobj), shoot(astuple(H1, ZERO), RIGHT))

    allobjs = combine(segs, combine(toprow, botrow))
    O = paint(Z, allobjs)
    return O
```

```python
    dims = shape(I)
    H = height(I)

    Z = canvas(ZERO, dims)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)

    const0 = lbind(identity, ZERO)
    startloc = fork(astuple, uppermost, const0)
    rowpatch = compose(rbind(shoot, RIGHT), startloc)
    rowobj = fork(recolor, color, rowpatch)
    rowobjs = mapply(rowobj, objs)

    # also include top and bottom edge rows colored by top/bottom objects
    topobj = argmin(objs, uppermost)
    botobj = argmax(objs, lowermost)
    toprow = recolor(color(topobj), shoot(astuple(ZERO, ZERO), RIGHT))
    H1 = decrement(H)
    botrow = recolor(color(botobj), shoot(astuple(H1, ZERO), RIGHT))

    # build vertical border segments split at midpoints between consecutive anchors
    pairs = product(objs, objs)
    ra = compose(uppermost, first)
    rb = compose(uppermost, last)
    ca = compose(color, first)
    cb = compose(color, last)
    cond = fork(greater, rb, ra)  # keep pairs with rb > ra
    ordpairs = sfilter(pairs, cond)

    W1 = decrement(W)
    constw1 = lbind(identity, W1)
    midf = compose(halve, fork(add, ra, rb))

    # left column segments
    a_left = fork(astuple, ra, const0)
    m_left = fork(astuple, midf, const0)
    b_left = fork(astuple, rb, const0)
    top2mid_l = fork(connect, a_left, m_left)
    mid2bot_l = fork(connect, compose(increment, midf), b_left)
    top2mid_l_obj = fork(recolor, ca, top2mid_l)
    mid2bot_l_obj = fork(recolor, cb, mid2bot_l)
    left_union = fork(combine, top2mid_l_obj, mid2bot_l_obj)

    # right column segments
    a_right = fork(astuple, ra, constw1)
    m_right = fork(astuple, midf, constw1)
    b_right = fork(astuple, rb, constw1)
    top2mid_r = fork(connect, a_right, m_right)
    mid2bot_r = fork(connect, compose(increment, midf), b_right)
    top2mid_r_obj = fork(recolor, ca, top2mid_r)
    mid2bot_r_obj = fork(recolor, cb, mid2bot_r)
    right_union = fork(combine, top2mid_r_obj, mid2bot_r_obj)

    pair_union = fork(combine, left_union, right_union)
    border_objs = mapply(pair_union, ordpairs)

    allobjs = combine(border_objs, combine(rowobjs, combine(toprow, botrow)))
    O = paint(Z, allobjs)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    dims = shape(I)
    H = height(I)
    Z = canvas(ZERO, dims)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)

    idxs = asindices(I)
    jL = leftmost(idxs)
    jR = rightmost(idxs)
    vL = tojvec(jL)
    vR = tojvec(jR)

    # full rows at anchors
    rvec = compose(toivec, uppermost)
    pL = compose(lbind(add, vL), rvec)
    pR = compose(lbind(add, vR), rvec)
    rowline = fork(connect, pL, pR)
    rowobj = fork(recolor, color, rowline)
    rowobjs = mapply(rowobj, objs)

    # consecutive pairs of anchors
    ords = order(objs, uppermost)
    headless = remove(last(ords), ords)
    tailless = remove(first(ords), ords)
    pairs = pair(headless, tailless)

    ra = compose(uppermost, first)
    rb = compose(uppermost, last)
    ca = compose(color, first)
    cb = compose(color, last)
    mid = compose(halve, fork(add, ra, rb))

    aL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, ra))
    mL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid))
    bL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, rb))
    aR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, ra))
    mR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, mid))
    bR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, rb))

    top2midL = fork(connect, aL, mL)
    mid2botL = fork(connect, compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, compose(increment, mid))), bL)
    top2midR = fork(connect, aR, mR)
    mid2botR = fork(connect, compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, compose(increment, mid))), bR)

    segL = fork(combine, fork(recolor, ca, top2midL), fork(recolor, cb, mid2botL))
    segR = fork(combine, fork(recolor, ca, top2midR), fork(recolor, cb, mid2botR))
    segPair = fork(combine, segL, segR)
    borders = mapply(segPair, pairs)

    # top and bottom edge rows by extremes
    topobj = argmin(objs, uppermost)
    botobj = argmax(objs, lowermost)
    topL = astuple(ZERO, jL)
    topR = astuple(ZERO, jR)
    H1 = decrement(H)
    botL = astuple(H1, jL)
    botR = astuple(H1, jR)
    toprow = recolor(color(topobj), connect(topL, topR))
    botrow = recolor(color(botobj), connect(botL, botR))

    allobjs = combine(borders, combine(rowobjs, combine(toprow, botrow)))
    O = paint(Z, allobjs)
    return O
```

```python
    mL1 = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid1))
```

```python
    rectUp = compose(backdrop, fork(combine, fork(connect, aL, mR), fork(connect, aR, mL)))

    lUp = fork(recolor, ca, compose(lbind(intersection, leftcol), outUp))
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    dims = shape(I)
    H = height(I)
    Z = canvas(ZERO, dims)

    idxs = asindices(I)
    jL = leftmost(idxs)
    jR = rightmost(idxs)
    vL = tojvec(jL)
    vR = tojvec(jR)
    TL = astuple(ZERO, jL)
    TR = astuple(ZERO, jR)
    BL = astuple(decrement(H), jL)
    BR = astuple(decrement(H), jR)
    leftcol = connect(TL, BL)
    rightcol = connect(TR, BR)

    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    ords = order(objs, uppermost)
    headless = remove(last(ords), ords)
    tailless = remove(first(ords), ords)
    pairs = pair(headless, tailless)

    ra = compose(uppermost, first)
    rb = compose(uppermost, last)
    ca = compose(color, first)
    cb = compose(color, last)
    mid = compose(halve, fork(add, ra, rb))
    mid1 = compose(increment, mid)

    aL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, ra))
    aR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, ra))
    bL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, rb))
    bR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, rb))
    mL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid))
    mR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, mid))
    mL1 = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid1))
    mR1 = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, mid1))

    segLUpRect = compose(backdrop, fork(connect, aL, mL))
    segRUpRect = compose(backdrop, fork(connect, aR, mR))
    segLDnRect = compose(backdrop, fork(connect, mL1, bL))
    segRDnRect = compose(backdrop, fork(connect, mR1, bR))

    lUp = fork(recolor, ca, compose(lbind(intersection, leftcol), segLUpRect))
    rUp = fork(recolor, ca, compose(lbind(intersection, rightcol), segRUpRect))
    lDn = fork(recolor, cb, compose(lbind(intersection, leftcol), segLDnRect))
    rDn = fork(recolor, cb, compose(lbind(intersection, rightcol), segRDnRect))
    pillars = mapply(fork(combine, fork(combine, lUp, rUp), fork(combine, lDn, rDn)), pairs)

    rvec = compose(toivec, uppermost)
    pL = compose(lbind(add, vL), rvec)
    pR = compose(lbind(add, vR), rvec)
    rows = mapply(fork(recolor, color, fork(connect, pL, pR)), ords)

    topobj = first(ords)
    botobj = last(ords)
    topc = color(topobj)
    botc = color(botobj)

    tLseg = recolor(topc, intersection(leftcol, backdrop(connect(TL, pL(topobj)))))
    tRseg = recolor(topc, intersection(rightcol, backdrop(connect(TR, pR(topobj)))))
    bLseg = recolor(botc, intersection(leftcol, backdrop(connect(pL(botobj), BL))))
    bRseg = recolor(botc, intersection(rightcol, backdrop(connect(pR(botobj), BR))))

    topfull = recolor(topc, connect(TL, TR))
    botfull = recolor(botc, connect(BL, BR))

    O = paint(Z, combine(rows, combine(pillars, combine(tLseg, combine(tRseg, combine(bLseg, combine(bRseg, combine(topfull, botfull))))))))
    return O
```

```python
    s5 = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    com2 = centerofmass(s2)
    com5 = centerofmass(s5)
    dirv = sign(subtract(com5, com2))
    s2p = shift(s2, double(dirv))
    w = width(s2p)
    h = height(s2p)
    mh = hmirror(s2p)
    mv = vmirror(s2p)
    offR = tojvec(w)
    offL = invert(offR)
    offD = toivec(h)
    offU = invert(offD)
    candR = shift(mh, offR)
    candL = shift(mh, offL)
    candD = shift(mv, offD)
    candU = shift(mv, offU)
    isR = equality(dirv, RIGHT)
    isL = equality(dirv, LEFT)
    isD = equality(dirv, DOWN)
    hor = either(isR, isL)
    bestRL = branch(isR, candR, candL)
    bestUD = branch(isD, candD, candU)
    best = branch(hor, bestRL, bestUD)
    obj2 = recolor(TWO, s2p)
    obj5 = recolor(FIVE, best)
    O = paint(paint(bg, obj2), obj5)
    return O
```

```python
    rel = position(s2p, s5)
    off = invert(rel)
    mh = hmirror(s2p)
    mv = vmirror(s2p)
    ph = shift(mh, off)
    pv = shift(mv, off)
    cset = insert(pv, initset(ph))
    best = argmin(cset, lbind(manhattan, s5))
    O = paint(paint(bg, recolor(TWO, s2p)), recolor(FIVE, best))
    return O
```

```python
    dims = shape(I)
    bg = canvas(SEVEN, dims)
    s2 = ofcolor(I, TWO)
    s5 = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    v = gravitate(s2, s5)
    s2p = shift(s2, v)
    hv = either(equality(sign(v), LEFT), equality(sign(v), RIGHT))
    corner = branch(hv, urcorner(s5), lrcorner(s5))

    s5rest = difference(toindices(s5), cset)
    moved = shift(cset, branch(hv, UP, LEFT))
    O = paint(bg, recolor(FIVE, s5rest))
    O = paint(O, recolor(FIVE, moved))
    O = paint(O, recolor(TWO, s2p))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Side-based extension of the 5-object toward the 2-object, and removal on the far side
    dims = shape(I)
    bg = canvas(SEVEN, dims)
    s2 = ofcolor(I, TWO)
    s5 = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    v = gravitate(s2, s5)
    d = sign(v)
    s2p = shift(s2, v)
    hv = either(equality(d, LEFT), equality(d, RIGHT))

    # rows and cols of the 5 square
    topRow = connect(ulcorner(s5), urcorner(s5))
    botRow = connect(llcorner(s5), lrcorner(s5))
    leftCol = connect(ulcorner(s5), llcorner(s5))
    rightCol = connect(urcorner(s5), lrcorner(s5))

    # choose nearer side (row/col) to the 2-object
    rows = insert(botRow, initset(topRow))
    cols = insert(rightCol, initset(leftCol))
    nearRow = argmin(rows, lbind(manhattan, s2))
    farRow = other(rows, nearRow)
    nearCol = argmin(cols, lbind(manhattan, s2))
    farCol = other(cols, nearCol)

    # decide endpoints per direction and side
    isTop = equality(nearRow, topRow)
    isBot = equality(farRow, botRow)
    isLeft = equality(nearCol, leftCol)
    isRight = equality(farCol, rightCol)

    endNearH = branch(equality(d, RIGHT), branch(isTop, urcorner(s5), lrcorner(s5)),
                                   branch(isTop, ulcorner(s5), llcorner(s5)))
    endFarH  = branch(equality(d, RIGHT), branch(isBot, lrcorner(s5), urcorner(s5)),
                                   branch(isBot, llcorner(s5), ulcorner(s5)))

    endNearV = branch(equality(d, DOWN), branch(isLeft, llcorner(s5), lrcorner(s5)),
                                   branch(isLeft, ulcorner(s5), urcorner(s5)))
    endFarV  = branch(equality(d, DOWN), branch(isRight, lrcorner(s5), llcorner(s5)),
                                   branch(isRight, urcorner(s5), ulcorner(s5)))

    endNear = branch(hv, endNearH, endNearV)
    endFar  = branch(hv, endFarH, endFarV)

    new = shift(initset(endNear), d)
    s5rest = difference(toindices(s5), initset(endFar))
    s5p = combine(s5rest, new)

    O = paint(bg, recolor(FIVE, s5p))
    O = paint(O, recolor(TWO, s2p))
    return O
```

```python
    s2 = ofcolor(I, TWO)
```

```python
    Iv = branch(condV, vmirror(I), I)
    s2v = ofcolor(Iv, TWO)
    s5v = ofcolor(Iv, FIVE)
    condH = greater(uppermost(s2v), uppermost(s5v))
    Ir = branch(condH, hmirror(Iv), Iv)

    s2r = ofcolor(Ir, TWO)
```

```python
    pal = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    mc = argmax(pal, lbind(colorcount, I))
    axisobj = toobject(ofcolor(I, mc), I)
    vmir = vmirror(axisobj)
    hmir = hmirror(axisobj)
    dmir = dmirror(axisobj)
    cmir = cmirror(axisobj)
    r180 = rot180(axisobj)
    u1 = combine(axisobj, vmir)
    u2 = combine(hmir, dmir)
    u3 = combine(cmir, r180)
    u12 = combine(u1, u2)
    u = combine(u12, u3)
    O = underpaint(I, u)
    return O
```

```python
    PN = shift(PC, D)
    G = replace(I, SIX, NINE)
    G = fill(G, FIVE, PC)
    O = fill(G, NINE, PN)
```

```python
    D = astuple(Di, Dj)
```
```python
    G = replace(I, SIX, NINE)
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational dominant-axis: choose H or V step by nearest-distance to external 9; also 6->9
    G = replace(I, SIX, NINE)
    P5 = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    B = inbox(P5)
    J = intersection(ofcolor(G, NINE), B)
    Ext = difference(ofcolor(G, NINE), B)
    Di0 = sign(subtract(uppermost(Ext), uppermost(B)))
    Dj0 = sign(subtract(leftmost(Ext), leftmost(B)))
    H = astuple(ZERO, Dj0)
    V = astuple(Di0, ZERO)
    dH = manhattan(shift(J, H), Ext)
    dV = manhattan(shift(J, V), Ext)
    D = branch(greater(dV, dH), H, V)
    O = fill(fill(G, FIVE, J), NINE, shift(J, D))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    cols = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    anchor = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    up = toivec(uppermost(anchor))
    f_patch = lbind(ofcolor, I)
    f_upvec = compose(toivec, compose(uppermost, f_patch))
    dv = compose(lbind(subtract, up), f_upvec)
    f_shift = fork(shift, f_patch, dv)
    f_obj = fork(recolor, identity, f_shift)
    allobj = mapply(f_obj, cols)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), allobj)
    return O
```

```python
    H5 = rbind(compose, invert)                            # H5(f) -> compose(invert, f)
    Cost = compose(H5, H4)                                 # Cost(seed) -> (target -> -size(intersection(...)))
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    tinds = toindices
    shL = rbind(shift, LEFT)
    shR = rbind(shift, RIGHT)
    hasR_fn = fork(intersection, tinds, compose(shL, tinds))  # has left neighbor
    hasL_fn = fork(intersection, tinds, compose(shR, tinds))  # has right neighbor
    union_fn = fork(merge, fork(insert, hasL_fn, compose(initset, hasR_fn)), compose(initset, initset))  # helper not directly used
    # Build endpoints via XOR = (hasL ∪ hasR) \ (hasL ∩ hasR)
    HL_sets = apply(hasL_fn, objs)
    HR_sets = apply(hasR_fn, objs)
    HL = merge(HL_sets)
    HR = merge(HR_sets)
    unionLR = merge(insert(HL, initset(HR)))
    bothLR = intersection(HL, HR)
    endpoints = difference(unionLR, bothLR)
    bg = ofcolor(I, ZERO)
    up_end = intersection(endpoints, shift(bg, UP))
    dn_end = intersection(endpoints, shift(bg, DOWN))
    bothUD = intersection(up_end, dn_end)
    O = paint(I, recolor(FOUR, endpoints))
    O = paint(O, recolor(TWO, bothUD))
    return O
```

```python
    bg = ofcolor(I, ZERO)

    nz = difference(U, bg)

    hasR_any = intersection(nz, shift(nz, RIGHT))
```

```python
    O = paint(O, recolor(FOUR, RB_outer))
    return O
```

```python
    S = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    SL = shift(S, LEFT)
    SR = shift(S, RIGHT)
    SU = shift(S, UP)
    SD = shift(S, DOWN)
    adjh = combine(intersection(S, SL), intersection(S, SR))

    iso = difference(S, adj_any)
    base = replace(I, FIVE, TWO)
    restore = toobject(iso, I)
    O = paint(base, restore)
    return O
```

```python
    recolored = mapply(lbind(recolor, TWO), others)
    O = paint(I, recolored)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Color filtering via global borders of top 1s: keep 5s under leftmost and rightmost 1-columns; others to 2
    P = ofcolor(tophalf(I), ONE)
    lj = leftmost(P)
    rj = rightmost(P)
    L = vfrontier(astuple(ZERO, lj))
    R = vfrontier(astuple(ZERO, rj))
    S = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    keepL = intersection(S, L)
    keepR = intersection(S, R)
    base = replace(I, FIVE, TWO)
    O = paint(paint(base, toobject(keepL, I)), toobject(keepR, I))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational/structural: use relation between horizontal and vertical periodicities
    obj8 = toobject(ofcolor(I, EIGHT), I)
    hp = hperiod(obj8)
    vp = vperiod(obj8)
    vals = insert(vp, initset(hp))
    val = minimum(vals)
    O = fill(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), val, ofcolor(I, EIGHT))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    S = compress(subgrid(ofcolor(I, TWO), I))
    L = first(vsplit(S, TWO))
    R = last(vsplit(S, TWO))
    LT = first(hsplit(L, TWO))
    LB = last(hsplit(L, TWO))
    RT = first(hsplit(R, TWO))
    RB = last(hsplit(R, TWO))
    CLT = compress(LT)
    CLB = compress(LB)
    CRT = compress(RT)
    CRB = compress(RB)
    OLT = recolor(TWO, normalize(toobject(ofcolor(CLT, TWO), CLT)))
    OLB = recolor(TWO, normalize(toobject(ofcolor(CLB, TWO), CLB)))
    ORT = recolor(TWO, normalize(toobject(ofcolor(CRT, TWO), CRT)))
    ORB = recolor(TWO, normalize(toobject(ofcolor(CRB, TWO), CRB)))
    OX = tojvec(FOUR)
    OY = toivec(FOUR)
    OD = add(OX, OY)
    SLT = shift(OLT, ORIGIN)
    SRT = shift(ORT, OX)
    SLB = shift(OLB, OY)
    SRB = shift(ORB, OD)
    U1 = combine(SLT, SRT)
    U2 = combine(SLB, SRB)
    U = combine(U1, U2)
    G = canvas(ZERO, astuple(SEVEN, SEVEN))
    O = paint(G, U)
    return O
```

```python
    Ft = branch(greater(FHt, FWt), FHt, FWt)

    Hb = height(B); Wb = width(B)
    FHb = divide(add(Hb, TWO), THREE); FWb = divide(add(Wb, TWO), THREE)
    Fb = branch(greater(FHb, FWb), FHb, FWb)

    SA = shift(OT, T1); SB = shift(OT, add(OX, T1))
    SC = shift(OB, add(OY, T1)); SD = shift(OB, add(OD, T1))

    R0 = astuple(THREE, ZERO); R6 = astuple(THREE, SIX)
    C0 = astuple(ZERO, THREE); C6 = astuple(SIX, THREE)
    ROW = connect(R0, R6); COL = connect(C0, C6)
    O = fill(P, ZERO, combine(ROW, COL))
    return O
```

```python
    S = compress(subgrid(ofcolor(I, TWO), I))
```

```python
    TLg = first(vsplit(T, TWO)); TRg = last(vsplit(T, TWO))
    BLg = first(vsplit(B, TWO)); BRg = last(vsplit(B, TWO))

    Htl = height(TLg); Wtl = width(TLg)
    FHtl = divide(add(Htl, TWO), THREE); FWtl = divide(add(Wtl, TWO), THREE)
    Ftl = branch(greater(FHtl, FWtl), FHtl, FWtl)
    Etl = compress(downscale(TLg, Ftl)); PTL = ofcolor(Etl, TWO)

    Htr = height(TRg); Wtr = width(TRg)
    FHtr = divide(add(Htr, TWO), THREE); FWtr = divide(add(Wtr, TWO), THREE)
    Ftr = branch(greater(FHtr, FWtr), FHtr, FWtr)
```

```python
    O = vconcat(vconcat(r1, r2), r3)
```

```python
    h1 = divide(H, THREE); h2 = divide(H, THREE); h12 = add(h1, h2); h3 = subtract(H, h12)
    w1 = divide(W, THREE); w2 = divide(W, THREE); w12 = add(w1, w2); w3 = subtract(W, w12)
    sr1 = ORIGIN; sr2 = toivec(h1); sr3 = toivec(h12)
    sc1 = ORIGIN; sc2 = tojvec(w1); sc3 = tojvec(w12)
    Gs = (
        crop(BB, add(sr1, sc1), astuple(h1, w1)),
        crop(BB, add(sr1, sc2), astuple(h1, w2)),
        crop(BB, add(sr1, sc3), astuple(h1, w3)),
        crop(BB, add(sr2, sc1), astuple(h2, w1)),
        crop(BB, add(sr2, sc2), astuple(h2, w2)),
        crop(BB, add(sr2, sc3), astuple(h2, w3)),
        crop(BB, add(sr3, sc1), astuple(h3, w1)),
        crop(BB, add(sr3, sc2), astuple(h3, w2)),
        crop(BB, add(sr3, sc3), astuple(h3, w3)),
    )
    dummy = initset(asobject(canvas(ZERO, UNITY)))
    choose = lambda G: color(argmax(combine(fgpartition(G), dummy), size))
    vals = tuple(apply(choose, Gs))
    r1 = hconcat(hconcat(canvas(vals[0], UNITY), canvas(vals[1], UNITY)), canvas(vals[2], UNITY))
    r2 = hconcat(hconcat(canvas(vals[3], UNITY), canvas(vals[4], UNITY)), canvas(vals[5], UNITY))
    r3 = hconcat(hconcat(canvas(vals[6], UNITY), canvas(vals[7], UNITY)), canvas(vals[8], UNITY))
    O = vconcat(vconcat(r1, r2), r3)
    return O
```

```python
    r1 = uppermost(FG); r3 = lowermost(FG); r2 = divide(add(r1, r3), TWO)
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    # Object extraction: pick three horizontal-line objects (size 2 or 3), order by vertical position, sample L/M/R
    FG = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    allobjs = objects(I, F, F, T)
    hlines = mfilter(allobjs, hline)
    L2 = sizefilter(hlines, TWO)
    L3 = sizefilter(hlines, THREE)
    lines = combine(L2, L3)
    rtop = uppermost(FG); rbot = lowermost(FG); rmid = divide(add(rtop, rbot), TWO)
    midrow = hfrontier(astuple(rmid, ZERO))
    top = argmin(lines, uppermost)
    bot = argmax(lines, lowermost)
    rest = remove(bot, remove(top, lines))
    dist_to_mid = compose(lbind(manhattan, midrow), toindices)
    mid = argmin(rest, dist_to_mid)
    mkrow = lambda o: (
        lambda G, W, c3, c2, v1, v2, v3, r:
            hconcat(hconcat(canvas(v1, UNITY), canvas(v2, UNITY)), canvas(v3, UNITY))
    )(
        subgrid(o, I),
        width(subgrid(o, I)),
        decrement(width(subgrid(o, I))),
        divide(decrement(width(subgrid(o, I))), TWO),
        index(subgrid(o, I), ORIGIN),
        index(subgrid(o, I), astuple(ZERO, divide(decrement(width(subgrid(o, I))), TWO))),
        index(subgrid(o, I), astuple(ZERO, decrement(width(subgrid(o, I))))),
        ZERO
    )
    R_top = mkrow(top)
    R_mid = mkrow(mid)
    R_bot = mkrow(bot)
    O = vconcat(vconcat(R_top, R_mid), R_bot)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Color filtering per 3x3 bin: replace zeros by leastcolor of bbox, then take mostcolor per bin
    FG = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    BB = subgrid(FG, I)
    base = leastcolor(BB)
    H = height(BB); W = width(BB)
    h1 = divide(H, THREE); h2 = divide(H, THREE); h12 = add(h1, h2); h3 = subtract(H, h12)
    w1 = divide(W, THREE); w2 = divide(W, THREE); w12 = add(w1, w2); w3 = subtract(W, w12)
    sr1 = ORIGIN; sr2 = toivec(h1); sr3 = toivec(h12)
    sc1 = ORIGIN; sc2 = tojvec(w1); sc3 = tojvec(w12)
    Gs = (
        crop(BB, add(sr1, sc1), astuple(h1, w1)),
        crop(BB, add(sr1, sc2), astuple(h1, w2)),
        crop(BB, add(sr1, sc3), astuple(h1, w3)),
        crop(BB, add(sr2, sc1), astuple(h2, w1)),
        crop(BB, add(sr2, sc2), astuple(h2, w2)),
        crop(BB, add(sr2, sc3), astuple(h2, w3)),
        crop(BB, add(sr3, sc1), astuple(h3, w1)),
        crop(BB, add(sr3, sc2), astuple(h3, w2)),
        crop(BB, add(sr3, sc3), astuple(h3, w3)),
    )
    choose = lambda G: mostcolor(replace(G, ZERO, base))
    vals = tuple(apply(choose, Gs))
    r1 = hconcat(hconcat(canvas(vals[0], UNITY), canvas(vals[1], UNITY)), canvas(vals[2], UNITY))
    r2 = hconcat(hconcat(canvas(vals[3], UNITY), canvas(vals[4], UNITY)), canvas(vals[5], UNITY))
    r3 = hconcat(hconcat(canvas(vals[6], UNITY), canvas(vals[7], UNITY)), canvas(vals[8], UNITY))
    O = vconcat(vconcat(r1, r2), r3)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    # Object extraction: pick three horizontal-line objects (top/mid/bot), sample L/M/R within each row object
    FG = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    HL = mfilter(objects(I, F, F, T), hline)
    rtop = uppermost(FG); rbot = lowermost(FG); rmid = divide(add(rtop, rbot), TWO)
    midrow = hfrontier(astuple(rmid, ZERO))
    top = argmin(HL, uppermost)
    bot = argmax(HL, lowermost)
    rest = remove(bot, remove(top, HL))
    dist_to_mid = compose(lbind(manhattan, midrow), toindices)
    mid = branch(equality(size(rest), ZERO), top, argmin(rest, dist_to_mid))
    mkrow = lambda o: (
        lambda S, W, j1, j2, j3:
            hconcat(
                hconcat(canvas(index(S, astuple(ZERO, j1)), UNITY),
                        canvas(index(S, astuple(ZERO, j2)), UNITY)),
                canvas(index(S, astuple(ZERO, j3)), UNITY)
            )
    )(
        subgrid(o, I),
        width(subgrid(o, I)),
        ZERO,
        divide(decrement(width(subgrid(o, I))), TWO),
        decrement(width(subgrid(o, I)))
    )
    R_top = mkrow(top)
    R_mid = mkrow(mid)
    R_bot = mkrow(bot)
    O = vconcat(vconcat(R_top, R_mid), R_bot)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Color filtering per horizontal third: pick most common nonzero color in each band (fallback 0), repeat across row
    FG = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    BB = subgrid(FG, I)
    H = height(BB); W = width(BB)

    R3 = hconcat(hconcat(canvas(v3, UNITY), canvas(v3, UNITY)), canvas(v3, UNITY))
```

```python
    S1 = crop(BB, ORIGIN, astuple(H, w1))
    S2 = crop(BB, tojvec(w1), astuple(H, w2))
    S3 = crop(BB, tojvec(w12), astuple(H, w3))
    colpick = lambda S: (
        lambda P, r1, r3, r2:
            vconcat(

                        branch(
                            equality(size(intersection(P, hfrontier(astuple(r1, ZERO)))), ZERO),

                        ), UNITY

                            ZERO,
                            index(S, astuple(r2, rightmost(intersection(P, hfrontier(astuple(r2, ZERO))))))
                        ), UNITY
                    )

                    branch(

                    ), UNITY

        uppermost(difference(asindices(S), ofcolor(S, ZERO))),

        divide(add(uppermost(difference(asindices(S), ofcolor(S, ZERO))), lowermost(difference(asindices(S), ofcolor(S, ZERO)))), TWO)
    )
    C1 = colpick(S1)
    C2 = colpick(S2)
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational: at FG extreme/mid intersections, cast rays in 4 directions; choose nearest object along rays
    FG = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    r1 = uppermost(FG); r3 = lowermost(FG); r2 = divide(add(r1, r3), TWO)
    c1 = leftmost(FG); c3 = rightmost(FG); c2 = divide(add(c1, c3), TWO)
    FGobjs = fgpartition(I)
    rays = lambda r, c: combine(
        combine(shoot(astuple(r, c), UP), shoot(astuple(r, c), DOWN)),
        combine(shoot(astuple(r, c), LEFT), shoot(astuple(r, c), RIGHT))
    )
    pick = lambda r, c: canvas(color(argmin(FGobjs, compose(lbind(manhattan, rays(r, c)), toindices))), UNITY)
    R1 = hconcat(hconcat(pick(r1, c1), pick(r1, c2)), pick(r1, c3))
    R2 = hconcat(hconcat(pick(r2, c1), pick(r2, c2)), pick(r2, c3))
    R3 = hconcat(hconcat(pick(r3, c1), pick(r3, c2)), pick(r3, c3))
    O = vconcat(vconcat(R1, R2), R3)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational: classify 8s by center-of-mass axes; on V-axis->2, on H-axis (excluding V)->3, rest->1
    p = ofcolor(I, EIGHT)
    c = centerofmass(p)
    vax = vfrontier(c)
    hax = hfrontier(c)
    onv = intersection(p, vax)
    rem = difference(p, onv)
    onh = intersection(rem, hax)
    rest = difference(rem, onh)
    base = replace(I, EIGHT, ZERO)
    O = paint(paint(paint(base, recolor(ONE, rest)), recolor(THREE, onh)), recolor(TWO, onv))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Relational/structural: gravitate each color’s non-border cells toward its border band, then repaint
    OB = objects(I, T, F, T)
    BOR = sfilter(OB, rbind(bordering, I))
    TOP = argmin(BOR, uppermost)
    BOT = argmax(BOR, lowermost)

    cT = color(TOP)
    cB = color(BOT)

    pAllT = ofcolor(I, cT)
    pBorT = toindices(TOP)
    pNonT = difference(pAllT, pBorT)
    dirT = gravitate(pNonT, TOP)
    movedT = shift(pNonT, dirT)

    pAllB = ofcolor(I, cB)
    pBorB = toindices(BOT)
    pNonB = difference(pAllB, pBorB)
    dirB = gravitate(pNonB, BOT)
    movedB = shift(pNonB, dirB)

    G1 = cover(I, toobject(pNonT, I))
    G2 = cover(G1, toobject(pNonB, I))
    G3 = fill(G2, cT, movedT)
    O  = fill(G3, cB, movedB)
    return O
```

```python
    BOT = argmax(BOR, lowermost)
    cT = color(TOP)
```

```python
    BO = colorfilter(OB, cB)
```

```python
    Bbor = sfilter(BO, rbind(bordering, I))
    Tnon = difference(TO, Tbor)
    Bnon = difference(BO, Bbor)
    UL = compose(ulcorner, inbox)
    RL = compose(hfrontier, UL)
    TI = compose(inbox, identity)
    TopEdge = fork(intersection, RL, TI)
    BLL = compose(llcorner, inbox)
    BRL = compose(hfrontier, BLL)
    BotEdge = fork(intersection, BRL, TI)
    Tedge = apply(fork(recolor, color, TopEdge), Tnon)
    Bedge = apply(fork(recolor, color, BotEdge), Bnon)
    H = height(I)
    Hm2 = subtract(H, TWO)
    drT = fork(subtract, lbind(identity, ONE), uppermost)
    vecT = compose(toivec, drT)
    drB = fork(subtract, lbind(identity, Hm2), lowermost)

    ST = fork(shift, identity, vecT)
    SB = fork(shift, identity, vecB)

    Bmov = apply(SB, Bedge)
    G = cover(cover(I, merge(Tnon)), merge(Bnon))
    O = paint(paint(G, merge(Tmov)), merge(Bmov))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Rotational symmetry with half-wise non-background packing: solve "compress-to-top" on I and on rot180(I), then rotate back and merge
    BG = mostcolor(I)
    OB = objects(I, T, F, T)
    BOR = sfilter(OB, rbind(bordering, I))
    TOP = argmin(BOR, uppermost)
    BOT = argmax(BOR, lowermost)
    cT = color(TOP)
    cB = color(BOT)
    H = height(I)
    Half = halve(H)
    TT = interval(ZERO, Half, ONE)
    FT = mapply(hfrontier, apply(toivec, TT))
    # Top-only on I
    ALL1 = asindices(I)
    NB1 = difference(ALL1, ofcolor(I, BG))
    Tcells1 = intersection(NB1, FT)
    Tobj1 = toobject(Tcells1, I)
    R01 = hfrontier(astuple(ZERO, ZERO))
    ST1 = fork(shift, identity, rbind(gravitate, R01))
    M1 = merge(apply(ST1, initset(Tobj1)))
    P1 = difference(toindices(M1), R01)
    Ct = canvas(BG, shape(I))
    Gt0 = fill(Ct, cT, P1)
    Gt = fill(Gt0, cT, R01)
    # Top-only on rot180(I), then rotate back
    V = rot180(I)
    HV = height(V)
    HalfV = halve(HV)
    TTV = interval(ZERO, HalfV, ONE)
    FTV = mapply(hfrontier, apply(toivec, TTV))
    ALL2 = asindices(V)
    NB2 = difference(ALL2, ofcolor(V, mostcolor(V)))
    Tcells2 = intersection(NB2, FTV)
    Tobj2 = toobject(Tcells2, V)
    R02 = hfrontier(astuple(ZERO, ZERO))
    ST2 = fork(shift, identity, rbind(gravitate, R02))
    M2 = merge(apply(ST2, initset(Tobj2)))
    P2 = difference(toindices(M2), R02)
    Cv = canvas(mostcolor(V), shape(V))
    Gv0 = fill(Cv, cB, P2)
    Gv = fill(Gv0, cB, R02)
    Gb = rot180(Gv)
    # Merge layers by underpainting over a background canvas
    O0 = canvas(BG, shape(I))
    O1 = underpaint(O0, asobject(Gt))
    O = underpaint(O1, asobject(Gb))
    return O
```

```python
    # Object extraction and sliding: gravitate interior objects in each half to their border; recolor; redraw borders
    BG = mostcolor(I)

    TB = interval(Half, H, ONE)

    FB = merge(mapply(hfrontier, apply(toivec, TB)))
    OB = objects(I, T, F, T)
    BOR = sfilter(OB, rbind(bordering, I))
    TopB = argmin(BOR, uppermost)
    BotB = argmax(BOR, lowermost)

    cB = color(BotB)

    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational: pull each half toward the center by half the inter-center offset and overlay
    J = replace(I, FIVE, FOUR)
    allidx = asindices(J)
    bg = ofcolor(J, FOUR)
    fg = difference(allidx, bg)
    idxL = asindices(lefthalf(J))
    idxR = asindices(righthalf(J))
    leftFG = intersection(fg, idxL)
    rightFG = intersection(fg, idxR)
    leftObj = toobject(leftFG, J)
    rightObj = toobject(rightFG, J)
    cL = center(idxL)
    cR = center(idxR)
    full = subtract(cR, cL)
    half = halve(full)
    movedL = shift(leftObj, half)
    movedR = shift(rightObj, invert(half))
    t = underpaint(canvas(FOUR, shape(J)), movedL)
    O = underpaint(t, movedR)
    return O
```

```python
    # Geometric: gravitate all foreground toward central cross (both axes)
    J = replace(I, FIVE, FOUR)
    allidx = asindices(J)
    fg = difference(allidx, ofcolor(J, FOUR))

    cross = combine(vln, hln)
    d = gravitate(fg, cross)
    O = move(canvas(FOUR, shape(J)), toobject(fg, J), d)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational via endpoint boxing: recolor 5s on pure straight 0-to-4 corridors using path bounding.
    p0 = ofcolor(I, ZERO)
    p4 = ofcolor(I, FOUR)
    p5 = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    linear = fork(either, hline, vline)
    paths04 = prapply(connect, p0, p4)
    allowed04 = merge(insert(p0, insert(p5, initset(p4))))
    pure04 = compose(lbind(equality, ZERO), compose(size, rbind(difference, allowed04)))
    good04 = mfilter(paths04, fork(both, pure04, linear))
    # Use bounding boxes of valid paths (degenerate to the path for straight lines)
    boxes = apply(backdrop, good04)
    linemask = merge(boxes)
    mask = intersection(linemask, p5)
    O = fill(I, TWO, mask)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    allidx = asindices(I)
    zeros = ofcolor(I, ZERO)
    nonzeros = difference(allidx, zeros)
    colors = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    comp = lbind(colorcount, I)
    c = valmax(colors, comp)
    mask_c = ofcolor(I, c)
    anchor = toobject(mask_c, I)
    others_mask = difference(nonzeros, mask_c)
    others = toobject(others_mask, I)
    cond_anchor = greater(size(mask_c), ZERO)
    cond_others = greater(size(others_mask), ZERO)
    cond = both(cond_anchor, cond_others)
    direction = branch(cond, gravitate(others, anchor), ORIGIN)
    moved_others = shift(others, direction)
    base = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O = paint(paint(base, anchor), moved_others)
    return O
```

```python
    P = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
```

```python
    O = fill(base, TWO, C)
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Object extraction by shape matching with a least-color exemplar
    val = leastcolor(I)
    parts = colorfilter(fgpartition(I), val)
    exemplar = argmax(parts, size)
    dims = shape(toindices(exemplar))
    onesobjs = colorfilter(fgpartition(I), ONE)
    getdims = compose(shape, toindices)
    eqdims = lbind(equality, dims)
    matches = sfilter(onesobjs, compose(eqdims, getdims))
    target = merge(apply(toindices, matches))
    O = fill(I, val, target)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Global cross through the overall center of mass of the least-color
    val = leastcolor(I)
    m = ofcolor(I, val)
    com = centerofmass(m)
    rows = hfrontier(com)
    cols = vfrontier(com)
    lines = combine(rows, cols)
    target = intersection(lines, ofcolor(I, ONE))
    O = fill(I, val, target)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    # Object extraction: fill ONE-objects entirely inside the least-color box
    val = leastcolor(I)
    rect = backdrop(ofcolor(I, val))
    onesobjs = colorfilter(fgpartition(I), ONE)
    idcs = toindices
    intr = compose(lbind(intersection, rect), idcs)
    pred = fork(equality, idcs, intr)
    matches = sfilter(onesobjs, pred)
    target = merge(apply(toindices, matches))
    O = fill(I, val, target)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric reasoning: fill ones on the diagonals of the least-color bounding box
    val = leastcolor(I)
    rect = backdrop(ofcolor(I, val))
    ul = ulcorner(rect)
    lr = lrcorner(rect)
    ur = urcorner(rect)
    ll = llcorner(rect)
    d1 = connect(ul, lr)
    d2 = connect(ur, ll)
    lines = combine(d1, d2)
    target = intersection(lines, ofcolor(I, ONE))
    O = fill(I, val, target)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Global: remove frontiers, select 1-objects sharing a row or column with least-color, then fill and restore
    val = leastcolor(I)
    fours = ofcolor(I, FOUR)
    J = cover(I, recolor(FOUR, fours))
    vp = ofcolor(J, val)
    ones = colorfilter(fgpartition(J), ONE)
    idx = toindices
    hitc = compose(lbind(vmatching, vp), idx)
    hitr = compose(lbind(hmatching, vp), idx)
    pred = fork(either, hitc, hitr)
    hits = sfilter(ones, pred)
    target = merge(apply(idx, hits))
    O = fill(I, val, target)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric: draw cross using row/column frontiers through least-color center; recolor intersecting ones
    val = leastcolor(I)
    vp = ofcolor(I, val)
    c = centerofmass(vp)
    hr = hfrontier(c)
    vr = vfrontier(c)
    s0 = initset(hr)
    s1 = insert(vr, s0)
    cross = merge(s1)
    target = intersection(cross, ofcolor(I, ONE))
    O = fill(I, val, target)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational: recolor 1-objects sharing a row or column with the least-color outline (box)
    val = leastcolor(I)
    rect = box(ofcolor(I, val))
    ones = colorfilter(fgpartition(I), ONE)
    idx = toindices
    rowhit = compose(lbind(hmatching, rect), idx)

    pred = fork(either, rowhit, colhit)

    target = merge(apply(idx, hits))
    O = fill(I, val, target)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric (vertical alignment): move only column-matching non-5 objects vertically until adjacent to five-clusters
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    fives = colorfilter(objs, FIVE)
    dest = mapply(toindices, fives)
    others = difference(objs, fives)
    colmatch = rbind(vmatching, dest)
    sel = sfilter(others, colmatch)
    rest = difference(others, sel)
    dirf = rbind(gravitate, dest)
    shifted = fork(shift, toindices, dirf)
    moved = fork(recolor, color, shifted)
    movedcells = mapply(moved, sel)
    restcells = merge(rest)
    fivecells = merge(fives)
    allcells = combine(fivecells, combine(movedcells, restcells))
    base = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O = paint(base, allcells)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    G = asindices(I)
    Os = objects(I, T, F, T)
    U = argmin(Os, uppermost)
    D = argmax(Os, lowermost)
    L = argmin(Os, leftmost)
    R = argmax(Os, rightmost)
    Top = hfrontier(ulcorner(G))
    Bot = hfrontier(llcorner(G))
    Lef = vfrontier(ulcorner(G))
    Rig = vfrontier(urcorner(G))
    O0 = fill(I, color(U), Top)
    O1 = fill(O0, color(D), Bot)
    O2 = fill(O1, color(L), Lef)
    O3 = fill(O2, color(R), Rig)
    O = fill(O3, ZERO, corners(G))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    Aobjs = colorfilter(objects(I, F, F, T), THREE)
    S = apply(toindices, Aobjs)
    shR = rbind(shoot, RIGHT)
    shL = rbind(shoot, LEFT)
    shU = rbind(shoot, UP)
    shD = rbind(shoot, DOWN)
    apR = rbind(apply, shR)
    apL = rbind(apply, shL)
    apU = rbind(apply, shU)
    apD = rbind(apply, shD)
    RRf = compose(merge, apR)
    LLf = compose(merge, apL)
    UUf = compose(merge, apU)
    DDf = compose(merge, apD)
    Hbtw = fork(intersection, RRf, LLf)
    Vbtw = fork(intersection, UUf, DDf)
    Mf = fork(intersection, Hbtw, Vbtw)
    coref = fork(difference, Mf, identity)
    deltaf = compose(delta, identity)
    Z = ofcolor(I, ZERO)
    iz = rbind(intersection, Z)
    delZ = compose(iz, deltaf)
    TGTf = fork(intersection, coref, delZ)
    Ts = apply(TGTf, S)
    TGT = merge(Ts)
    O = underfill(I, FOUR, TGT)
    return O
```

```python
    rows_in_box = fork(intersection, HRf, Bf)
    cols_in_box = fork(intersection, VRf, Bf)
    Mf = fork(intersection, rows_in_box, cols_in_box)
    coref = fork(difference, Mf, identity)
    Z = ofcolor(I, ZERO)
    iz = rbind(intersection, Z)
    delZ = compose(iz, compose(delta, identity))
    TGTf = fork(intersection, coref, delZ)
    Ts = apply(TGTf, S)
    TGT = merge(Ts)
    O = underfill(I, FOUR, TGT)
    return O
```

```python
    # Color filtering with subgrid objects: zeros in subgrid not bordering its frame
    A = ofcolor(I, THREE)
    S = subgrid(A, I)
    ObjFun1 = rbind(objects, T)
    ObjFun2 = rbind(ObjFun1, F)

    HolesS = toindices(merge(NonBorder))
    H = shift(HolesS, ulcorner(A))
    O = underfill(I, FOUR, H)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational/structural: zeros inside any 3-object bbox but not near bbox border
    O3 = colorfilter(objects(I, T, F, T), THREE)
    BBs = merge(apply(backdrop, O3))
    Boxes = merge(apply(box, O3))
    NearBorder = merge(apply(dneighbors, Boxes))
    Z = ofcolor(I, ZERO)
    InBBoxes = intersection(Z, BBs)
    Deep = difference(InBBoxes, NearBorder)
    A = ofcolor(I, THREE)
    H = intersection(Deep, delta(A))
    O = underfill(I, FOUR, H)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    nz = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
```
```python
    sub = subgrid(nz, I)
```

```python
    c = argmax(pal, lbind(colorcount, I))
    outline = recolor(c, bbox)
    base = normalize(outline)
    wI = width(I)
    hI = height(I)
    ws = width(sub)
    hs = height(sub)
    offsH = interval(0, wI, ws)
    vecsH = apply(tojvec, offsH)
    tileH = mapply(lbind(shift, base), vecsH)
    offsV = interval(0, hI, hs)
    vecsV = apply(toivec, offsV)
    tileHV = mapply(lbind(shift, tileH), vecsV)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), tileHV)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    # Object-period tiling: tile all normalized objects by minimal object bbox sizes
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    bbs = apply(lbind(subgrid, I), objs)
    ws = apply(width, bbs)
    hs = apply(height, bbs)
    pH = minimum(ws)
    pV = minimum(hs)
    norms = apply(normalize, objs)
    wI = width(I)
    hI = height(I)
    offsH = interval(0, wI, pH)
    vecsH = apply(tojvec, offsH)
    copiesH = prapply(shift, norms, vecsH)
    tileH = merge(copiesH)
```

```python
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    bbs = apply(rbind(subgrid, I), objs)
    ws = apply(width, bbs)
    hs = apply(height, bbs)
    pH = minimum(ws)
    pV = minimum(hs)
    norms = apply(normalize, objs)
    wI = width(I)
    hI = height(I)
    offsH = interval(0, wI, pH)
    vecsH = apply(tojvec, offsH)

    tileH = merge(copiesH)
    offsV = interval(0, hI, pV)
    vecsV = apply(toivec, offsV)
    tileHV = mapply(lbind(shift, tileH), vecsV)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), tileHV)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational/structural: per-half delta mask underfill + preserve non-modal objects
    fgobjs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    fg = merge(fgobjs)
    G = subgrid(fg, I)
    L = lefthalf(G)
    R = righthalf(G)
    fL = merge(objects(L, T, F, T))
    fR = merge(objects(R, T, F, T))
    mL = normalize(delta(fL))
    mR = shift(normalize(delta(fR)), tojvec(width(L)))
    S = insert(mR, initset(mL))
    mask = merge(S)
    bg = underfill(G, mostcolor(fg), mask)
    modal = mostcolor(fg)
    othersobjs = difference(fgobjs, colorfilter(fgobjs, modal))
    O = underpaint(bg, normalize(merge(othersobjs)))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational/structural: recolor nonzero left/right halves with least/most colors respectively
    fgobjs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    fg = merge(fgobjs)
    G = subgrid(fg, I)
    Z = ofcolor(G, ZERO)
    NZ = difference(asindices(G), Z)
    wL = width(lefthalf(G))
    Lbox = asindices(lefthalf(G))
    Rbox = shift(asindices(righthalf(G)), tojvec(wL))
    Lmask = intersection(NZ, Lbox)
    Rmask = intersection(NZ, Rbox)
    A = leastcolor(fg)
    Bc = mostcolor(fg)
    LO = recolor(A, Lmask)
    RO = recolor(Bc, Rmask)
    base = replace(G, ZERO, Bc)
    O = paint(base, merge(insert(RO, initset(LO))))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational: fill interior gaps (delta of FG) with modal color, then draw FG outline with least-common color
    fg = merge(objects(I, T, F, T))
    G = subgrid(fg, I)
    holes = delta(fg)
    B = fill(G, mostcolor(fg), holes)
    outline = box(fg)
    O = fill(B, leastcolor(fg), outline)
    return O
```

```python
    # Relational: connect centers of leftmost and rightmost {1,2,4,8} objects in bottom half with 3-wire and keep them
    B = bottomhalf(I)
    parts = objects(B, T, F, T)
    a = colorfilter(parts, ONE)
    b = colorfilter(parts, TWO)
    c = colorfilter(parts, FOUR)
    d = colorfilter(parts, EIGHT)
    selparts = merge((a, merge((b, merge((c, d))))))  # union of selected color objects
    L = argmin(selparts, leftmost)
    R = argmax(selparts, rightmost)
    c1 = center(L)
    c2 = center(R)
    wire = recolor(THREE, connect(c1, c2))
    sel = combine(combine(ofcolor(B, ONE), ofcolor(B, TWO)), combine(ofcolor(B, FOUR), ofcolor(B, EIGHT)))
    obj = toobject(sel, B)
    both = combine(obj, wire)
    off = astuple(halve(height(I)), ZERO)
    O = move(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), both, off)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational: in bottom half, keep {1,2,4,8} and add a 3-wire: bottom edge + verticals at extreme columns within their bbox
    B = bottomhalf(I)
    p1 = ofcolor(B, ONE)
    p2 = ofcolor(B, TWO)
    p4 = ofcolor(B, FOUR)
    p8 = ofcolor(B, EIGHT)
    sel = combine(combine(p1, p2), combine(p4, p8))
    bl = llcorner(sel)
    br = lrcorner(sel)
    base = recolor(THREE, connect(bl, br))
    BB = backdrop(sel)
    vL = intersection(vfrontier(bl), BB)
    vR = intersection(vfrontier(br), BB)
    pillars = recolor(THREE, combine(vL, vR))
    obj = toobject(sel, B)
    both = combine(obj, combine(base, pillars))
    off = astuple(halve(height(I)), ZERO)
    O = move(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), both, off)
    return O
```

```python
    R = rot180(I)
    i1 = ofcolor(I, ONE); i2 = ofcolor(I, TWO); i3 = ofcolor(I, THREE); i4 = ofcolor(I, FOUR); i8 = ofcolor(I, EIGHT)
    r1 = ofcolor(R, ONE); r2 = ofcolor(R, TWO); r3 = ofcolor(R, THREE); r4 = ofcolor(R, FOUR); r8 = ofcolor(R, EIGHT)

    SR = combine(combine(combine(r1, r2), combine(r3, r4)), r8)
    oI = toobject(SI, I)
    oR = toobject(SR, R)
    both = combine(oI, oR)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), both)
    return O
```

```python
    OBJS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    OE = colorfilter(OBJS, EIGHT)
    OS = colorfilter(OBJS, SEVEN)
    FG = difference(OBJS, combine(OE, OS))

    BASE = cover(I, merge(IDX))
    O = underpaint(BASE, merge(MOV))
    return O
```

```python
    D = gravitate(toindices(OQ), E)
    M = shift(OQ, D)
    B = cover(I, toobject(OI, I))
    O = underpaint(B, M)
    return O
```

```python
    OFF = subtract(TJV, SJV)
    M = shift(U, OFF)
    B = cover(I, U)
    O = underpaint(B, M)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    s = mostcolor(I)
    dims = shape(I)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    fg = mfilter(objs, compose(flip, matcher(color, s)))

    colors = apply(color, fg)
    groups = apply(lbind(colorfilter, fg), colors)

    pairsF = fork(product, identity, identity)

    # Vertical rectangles (same column)
    vPairs = compose(lbind(mfilter, fork(vmatching, first, last)), pairsF)
    vRectIdx = compose(backdrop, fork(combine, first, last))
    vCol = compose(color, first)
    vCan = compose(rbind(canvas, dims), vCol)
    vObj = fork(toobject, vRectIdx, vCan)
    vPairObjs = compose(lbind(apply, vObj), vPairs)
    perGroupV = compose(merge, vPairObjs)
    PVset = apply(perGroupV, groups)
    PV = merge(PVset)

    # Horizontal rectangles (same row)
    hPairs = compose(lbind(mfilter, fork(hmatching, first, last)), pairsF)
    hRectIdx = compose(backdrop, fork(combine, first, last))
    hCol = compose(color, first)
    hCan = compose(rbind(canvas, dims), hCol)
    hObj = fork(toobject, hRectIdx, hCan)
    hPairObjs = compose(lbind(apply, hObj), hPairs)
    perGroupH = compose(merge, hPairObjs)
    PHset = apply(perGroupH, groups)
    PH = merge(PHset)

    P = combine(PV, PH)
    O = underpaint(I, P)
    return O
```

```python
    hCan = compose(rbind(canvas, dims), hCol)
    hObj = fork(toobject, hIdx, hCan)
    hRects = apply(hObj, hPairs)
    PH = merge(hRects)

    P = combine(PV, PH)
    O = underpaint(I, P)
```

```python
    mk = fork(toobject, interior, can)
    perGroup = compose(merge, compose(lbind(apply, mk), filtPairs))
    P = merge(apply(perGroup, groups))
    O = underpaint(I, P)
    return O
```

```python
    O = underpaint(I, P)
```
